drugs.name: Ipilimumab
drugs.mechanism: Anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody that relieves T-cell inhibition.
drugs.efficacy: Improves survival in advanced melanoma and is used with nivolumab.

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.mechanism: Anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody that restores T-cell effector function.
drugs.efficacy: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab improved 10-year survival in advanced melanoma.
drugs.disease_evidence: PD-1 blockade in advanced and resected melanoma.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.mechanism: Anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody that restores T-cell effector function.
drugs.efficacy: Active in advanced and resected melanoma, including adjuvant use.
drugs.disease_evidence: PD-1 blockade in advanced and resected melanoma.

drugs.name: Dabrafenib
drugs.efficacy: With trametinib improves relapse-free survival in stage III BRAF-mutant melanoma.

drugs.name: Trametinib
drugs.efficacy: With dabrafenib improves outcomes in BRAF-mutant melanoma.

drugs.name: Vemurafenib
drugs.efficacy: Improved survival versus dacarbazine in BRAF V600E melanoma.

drugs.name: Encorafenib
drugs.efficacy: With binimetinib improves survival in BRAF-mutant melanoma.

drugs.name: Relatlimab
drugs.efficacy: With nivolumab improves progression-free survival versus nivolumab alone.
drugs.disease_evidence: LAG-3 blockade combined with PD-1 blockade.

drugs.name: Talimogene laherparepvec
drugs.mechanism: Oncolytic herpes simplex virus type 1 engineered to express GM-CSF.
drugs.efficacy: Improves durable response rate in advanced melanoma.
drugs.disease_evidence: Intralesional oncolytic immunotherapy for injectable lesions.

drugs.name: Cobimetinib
drugs.efficacy: With vemurafenib for BRAF-mutant advanced melanoma.
drugs.disease_evidence: MEK inhibition combined with BRAF inhibition.

drugs.name: Naporafenib
drugs.efficacy: With trametinib showed efficacy in NRAS-mutant melanoma.
drugs.disease_evidence: Investigational pan-RAF inhibitor for NRAS-mutant melanoma.
